# VaidTrack.com (kenyalandingpage)

Static cancer medical-tourism site: https://www.vaidtrack.com  
Repo: https://github.com/mnadwi3/kenyalandingpage

## Key files
- index.html — homepage
- assets/css/styles.css — home styles (tx-card treatments, doc-card doctors, how-it-works journey)
- assets/js/main.js — slider, FAQ, forms, clean section URLs, DOM section order
- assets/js/doctors.js — fetches data/doctors/doctors.json and renders doctor cards
- data/doctors/doctors.json — doctor profiles (images in images/doctors-images/)
- treatments/*.html + assets/css/treatment-page.css + assets/js/treatment-page.js — per-cancer pages
- .htaccess / _redirects — extensionless clean URLs

## Clean paths
/treatment /doctors /how-it-works /visa-travel /testimonials /about-us /faq /contact /book-appointment  
/treatments/{cancer-slug} /privacy-policy /disclaimer

## Brand

## Notes
Doctor profiles are loaded from doctors.json — verify credentials before launch.
Ads final URL: https://www.vaidtrack.com/
